head_commit.message:
fix(evidence): close owned readers and preserve primary failures

Keep encrypted evidence streams under explicit descriptor ownership, drain owned resources once, and preserve original read failures across cleanup. Protect the governance archive reader's initial directory identity check and retain its primary failure on close errors.

Add 15 isolated behavioral regression methods with old-source negative controls. Retain independent R2 reviews, 73-test and 40-test focused receipts, canonical discovery of 5,575 IDs, and frozen-source preservation evidence. Native warm execution and phase acceptance remain unstarted.
